trace.question: Calculate the percentage of the cards availabe in Chinese Simplified.
trace.evidence: Chinese Simplified' is the language; percentage = Divide(Sum(id where language = 'Chinese Simplified'), Count(id)) *100

attempts.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(id) AS percentage
FROM foreign_data

trace.final_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(id) AS percentage
FROM foreign_data
trace.answer: About 8.77% of the cards are available in Chinese Simplified.
